# Bodycam Shows Moment Cops Arrested a Man for Speaking Too Long at Data Center Meeting

In February, police in Claremore, Oklahoma [arrested farmer Darren Blanchard](https://www.404media.co/man-opposing-data-center-arrested-for-speaking-slightly-too-long/) for speaking a little too long during a community meeting about data centers. The city charged Blanchard with criminal trespass, a crime with a $200 penalty, but he’s [vowed to fight the charge](https://www.404media.co/farmer-arrested-for-speaking-too-long-at-datacenter-town-hall-vows-to-fight/). He recently shared video of the bodycam footage for the first time with 404 Media and answered our questions about the moment cops arrested him for going over his time at a February 17 community meeting of the Claremore City Council.

The plan in February was for the City Council to listen to the concerns citizens had about a planned [data center](https://bealeinfra.com/claremore-oklahoma/?ref=404media.co) called [Project Mustang](https://claremore.com/project-mustang-faq/?ref=404media.co). The residents of Claremore [don’t want the data center](https://www.fox23.com/news/project-mustang-data-center-project-facing-pushback-in-claremore/article_186bac6f-baf0-4c3c-8f42-83bd47fed3fc.html?ref=404media.co) and largely feel like the construction project was approved without their input. City officials signed non-disclosure agreements on behalf of the project’s developers and haven’t been forthcoming with details about its construction.
